pr_title: chore: Sync the id when DefaultHttp2FrameStream's stream is updated.
pr_body:
Motivation:

Keep the id in sync

Modification:

update the id when stream is updated.

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/14801

issue_context.title: DefaultHttp2FrameStream's id is not sync with stream
issue_context.body: The `id` should be updated when the stream is been set.

review_comments: hmm... There must be a bug then as we actually guard against this in the assert above.
I don't get it... What I mean is the assert above basically should trigger. So either the assert is wrong or something else is fishy..

the `newStream` call creates a new `DefaultHttp2FrameStream` which `id` is `-1` and the assert will pass when you first call `setStreamAndProperty`, I think the code is right, just not handy when you do debug which shows `-1` in debugger.
